_README: Canonical Production Progress record. BINDING SESSION RULE: every session that changes MATRIYA must append a session entry here (newest first) BEFORE it closes, in the same PR as the change. If nothing really changed in production, append an entry with no_production_change: true. Stages: CODED (exists on a branch) < MERGED (in main) < DEPLOYED (running in production) < LIVE_VERIFIED (verified against production at runtime). A capability may never be presented as an improvement while it is only CODED. GET /progress renders this record and upgrades stages with runtime self-checks.
